comment: Worked out by hand. Walls: the 20 x 10 rectangle's walls 15 up (the parameter height), 2 (20 + 10) 15 = 900, and the open L of two 10 lines beside it, 20 x 15 = 300. Drum: a line 5 off the Z axis from z 0 to 10 turned a full turn, 2 pi 5 10 = 314.159. Swept: a 10 line at x 60..70 swept 20 up along a line of the XZ plane (its y down is z up), 200. Skin: a 10 line at y 30 lofted to the same line 10 above, ruled, 100. All surfaces, none a solid.
